stance: C2PA is actively extending its provenance perimeter into the music sector, attempting to standardize audio media tracking alongside its existing specification suite.
adoption_shape: The coalition has formally broadened its documented scope to include audio-specific media provenance, though the update currently represents top-down guidance rather than recorded adoption moves from music industry players.
new_entrants: The coalition itself has expanded into the music domain to establish baseline governance for audio assets alongside its established coverage of general AI and security.
watch_for: Whether actual music implementers begin applying the audio-specific guidance alongside the 2.5 technical specification suite.
